texts: Why do Keepers count many sky-cats on the cliff-spires in the morning in late summer?

fields.sentence: Why do Keepers count many sky-cats on the cliff-spires in the morning in late summer?
parse: (: $prf (And (Member $k keeper) (Member $e count) (Agent $e $k) (Theme $e $g) (GroupOf $g sky_cat) (CardinalityPhrase $g "many") (Location $e $s) (GroupOf $s cliff_spire) (Time $e morning) (Time $e late_summer) (ReasonFor $r $e)) $tv)

q2_gaps: a modified sub-season period ("late summer") - the Time inventory has Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute terms, deictic season constants and day-part symbols, but no rule for an "early/late <season>" expression or for whether it fuses into one constant
review.notes: "many" counting things is licensed for CardinalityPhrase ("use CardinalityPhrase only when the phrase counts things"), the bare capitalized plural "Keepers" correctly takes the capitalized-common-noun default, and Theme is right for count. "On the cliff-spires" is attached to the counting event rather than to the sky-cats; both attachments are coherent, and a question is translated single-form by rule, so this is a reading choice rather than a defect.
